resources.string: Steps, active calories and exercise from this phone go into this person\'s log only.

Fagerteam Coach reads three things from Health Connect, for the last two weeks at most:

• Steps
• Active calories burned
• Exercise sessions (to total your exercise minutes)

It reads them each time you open the app and saves each day's totals to your Fagerteam Coach log in Claude, where your step goal, calorie budget and coach use them. It never writes to Health Connect, reads nothing else, and shares nothing with anyone outside your family's coach.

You can turn access off anytime in Health Connect.
This phone\'s Android System WebView is too old to pass steps and exercise to the coach. Update Android System WebView in the Play Store to turn syncing on. Everything else works as usual.
